listing.releaseNotes:
Rebranded to Splyt — new name, new icon. Same app, same data, nothing you
need to do.

Splyt opens with a new animation — the wordmark splits down the middle and
pulls back to your Home.

Your Apple Watch opens on a microphone. Tap it, say "basketball", "start my
plan", "rest day" — it counts down 3-2-1 and starts.

Say your split out loud and Splyt builds it. It reads gym shorthand, times
said loosely — "half four", "after work" — and a rambling take where the
days and times arrive in any order.

The watch rest screen is redesigned: a ring counting down, your heart rate,
−30s / +30s in the corners. Swipe right to see your next set, left for your
music.

Fix sets by voice. "I started with 10 pounds and then did 30 for the rest"
corrects the sets you already logged instead of piling more underneath them.

A personal record is a moment now. The rest bar opens into a card showing
how far you beat your best, and the set keeps the trophy.

Send your week to your trainer. The Weekly Recap exports your training day
by day, PRs, weight, steps, sleep and habits — as a PDF, or a private link
that opens in any browser. You pick what goes in it.

The training calendar is redrawn — one row a day, today raised with its
sessions already open — and the home screen widget matches it. Copy a day
you've already planned and it lands with its times.

Share a workout with anyone. Your summary opens as a web page, so friends
without Splyt can see what you did — and tapping a splyt.fit link opens it
straight in the app.

Browse the whole exercise library from Stats without starting a workout.
Search it, filter by body part, tap any record to open that exercise.

Closing your Splyt ring flashes and glows. Your watch counts rows and other
horizontal pulls.

A phone you've used before opens on "Welcome back" — one tap to continue.

Plus a faster way to start a workout, and a long list of fixes.
listing.description:
Staying consistent is hard when you're juggling five apps, guessing what to do next, or starting over every Monday. Splyt is one structured place for your training — with a coach that knows you, hardware that talks to your gym, and friends who keep you honest.

Track everything that matters.
Log lifts, cardio, sleep, food, weight, and habits in seconds. Supersets, drop sets, warm-up and failure sets, per-set reps, and reps-in-reserve are all first-class, in a keyboard built for lifting. Plan your week with templates and folders, and build a history that reflects your real effort.

Your AI coach, not just a chatbot.
Splyt AI remembers your goals, injuries, and routines across every conversation. Ask it anything — it draws charts from your data, drafts full templates, builds and edits week-long splits, searches the web when you need what's current, and can fill your live session in real time. Prefer to talk? Hands-free voice mode, with a lineup of natural voices and a vibe to match, from Calm to Drill Sergeant.

Your watch counts your reps.
Apple Watch automatically counts reps on bench, shoulder press, curls, squats, triceps work, and flyes — live on your wrist, with a giant readout on your phone. Log sets by voice mid-workout. Start on your phone and your watch follows automatically, even if the app was closed.

Connect to the machines at your gym.
Pair Splyt to a treadmill, bike, rower, elliptical, or stair climber over Bluetooth and get real speed, distance, incline, cadence, stroke rate, and power — no more wrist-estimated distance. Works with most modern machines. No Bluetooth? Snap a photo of the console and Splyt reads your metrics straight in.

Every kind of workout — and recovery too.
Strength, outdoor runs with live route maps, pool swimming with lap counting, basketball, boxing with round timers, yoga, HIIT circuits. Sauna, cold plunge, ice bath, and massage count as part of your training, not outside it.

One ring for your whole day.
Your Splyt ring blends workouts, sleep, and habits into a single daily target — no Apple Watch required. Set your Move, Exercise, and Stand goals right in Splyt, pick from dozens of ring colorways, and put it all on your lock screen, home screen, or watch face.

Real accountability, not a public feed.
Friends see each other's workouts, habits, and check-ins in a private activity feed. Comment, react, watch a friend's live workout as it happens, or go head-to-head — compete on workouts, volume, steps, sleep, minutes, even who gets to bed earliest. No public posts. No fake likes.

Know what's actually happening.
Volume by body part, daily strain, training times, steps, sleep stages, and weight trends — plus a weekly AI recap of the week you actually had.

Key Features

Workout Tracking — lifting, cardio, sports, swimming, boxing, yoga, recovery
Auto Rep Counting — Apple Watch counts your reps on major lifts
Smart Gym Machines — Bluetooth treadmills, bikes, rowers, ellipticals, stair climbers
Machine Photo Scan — snap the console and import your metrics
Splyt AI Coach (Pro) — memory, charts, voice mode, AI-built splits and templates
Outdoor Tracking — live pace, distance, and route maps with just your phone
Competitions — 1-on-1 and group, tracked automatically from your data
Groups & Friends — private accountability groups and a live friends feed
Progress Photos (Pro) — private photos with optional AI physique analysis
Lifestyle Tracking — sleep, weight, habits, and food you can log in plain English
Apple Watch — auto sync, activity-specific live views, voice logging, complications
Widgets — training calendar, habits, streaks, and rings on home and lock screen
Siri — start, pause, resume, or end any workout by voice
Apple Health Sync — sleep stages, two-way workout sync
Import / Export — Strong, Hevy, CSV, a pasted note, or a link to a workout video

Track your effort. Learn your patterns. Stay accountable with the people who matter.
